detail.title: 直通真空泵
detail.abstract: The present invention relates to a kind of vacuum pump, particularly relate to straight-through vacuum pump therein.The straight-through vacuum pump of the present invention includes: cylindrical outer cover；The ejector arranged in series in the upside within outer housing and downside and guide；The fixture joint being combined with outer housing bottom.Described guide is that the suction of compressed-air actuated discharge and air-out provides corresponding path and passage.According to the present invention, design and the utilization of device are all more prone to than original technology, it can be ensured that the generation of vacuum and maintenance reach stable effect.It addition, the selection of ejector and application are also the most freely.
assignees: 韩国气压系统有限公司
